frozenEnvironment.layout: Masonry allocated by HA; native three Tile surfaces per group, experimental fixed three internal buttons
frozenEnvironment.content: First reading, Second reading, Body intent; synthetic A/B sources; independent A/B/body targets
frozenEnvironment.allocation: HA affinity two allowed cores; browser/driver use host affinity; no per-container CPU or memory limit claimed
frozenEnvironment.network: All-namespace HA, loopback relay; browser proxy rejects non-loopback; service workers blocked; no request routing

startupLimitations.limitation: Network-isolated HA can emit offline startup resolver/analytics/marketplace warnings; this is a synthetic lab, not production compatibility evidence. Raw HA logs/private state are not published.

constraints: Shared LXC host; affinity and pinned versions are recorded, without claiming fixed CPU frequency, an exclusive host or reference-phone equivalence
